CustomField.description: This field will be set to "Cancellation/pending for Repricing" upon initiation of cancellation approval workflow.
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( TEXT(Booking_Unit_Status__c) = "Sold", Submitted_for_Cancellation__c ), "Cancelled/pending for Repricing", TEXT(Booking_Unit_Status__c) )
CustomField.label: Unit Cancellation Status
